root_cause.text: The `chacha_block_generic` and `hchacha_block_generic` functions in the ChaCha stream cipher implementation fail to zeroize the local `permuted_state` variable before it goes out of scope, leaving sensitive cryptographic state on the stack from which the original key can be reconstructed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `chacha_zeroize_state(&permuted_state)` to the end of both `chacha_block_generic` and `hchacha_block_generic` in `lib/crypto/chacha-block-generic.c` to clear the stack variable before the functions return.
